verdict.rationale: Extend is a hosted SaaS document-processing platform, but its pricing page lists "BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments" as an enterprise option. Its compliance docs also refer to security controls "across all deployment options," so the core platform can run inside a customer's own cloud. The evidence is only feature bullets: no deployment docs, no open-source core, and it appears tied to an enterprise plan rather than being freely self-hostable. Missing for 10: self-hosting/BYOC deployment documentation, an open-source or freely self-hostable core, clarity on which tier unlocks BYOC, and independent or hands-on confirmation of running it in one's own infrastructure.
